name: Axe throwing and game venues

pf.license.need: where the state's rules require it: the business's registration, and a permit for the lanes where the state requires one; a mobile lane follows the same rules where they cover it
pf.license.ask: the business registration, and any state permit for the lanes with its last inspection date; the liability insurance certificate
pf.license.check: none: Rosie never looks up, checks or confirms a license, insurance or registration (D96); anything shown is as given by the business, not checked by Rosie
pf.license.blocks: goes live on identity and the registration; where the state requires a permit, only once it's on file
pf.license.renewals: permits and insurance reminded 30 and 7 days before; a lapse pauses new bookings
pf.license.insurance: liability insurance for the lanes and for events at a customer's place, as the state or the venue asks
pf.license.staff: lane hosts trained by the venue, with first-aid and CPR cards (certificates, not state licenses)
pf.license.background: background checks for hosts who work with children, where the venue or the rules require them

pf.services.shape: table: a lane is a space for an hour (up to 4 throwers) or for a set party; each lane holds a set number of throwers per start time
pf.services.examples: the example venue's own prices (Lee Axe Lanes, and Lee Mobile Axes for a lane at a customer's place), not a standard

list.name: Birthday party package, 10 throwers, 2 hours
list.price: $200 for 10 throwers, $20 each extra, up to 16
list.kind: one price per party, with a minimum
list.length: 2 hours: a lane for 90 minutes, then 30 minutes in the party room
list.after: the $160 rest paid at the counter on the day, for the final count

list.name: Mobile lanes for a company event (2 hours, 2 lanes, up to 20 throwers)
list.before: a $100 deposit once the booking is confirmed
list.after: the $300 rest charged to the saved card when the crew texts DONE

list.name: Backyard party, 10 throwers, 2 hours
list.before: a card saved for the $60 late-cancel fee
list.after: the bill texted after the party

list.name: Mobile lane, 1 hour at home (up to 4 throwers)

pf.services.capacity: lanes per start time, set by the number of lanes and the venue's safety limit; a party room is a space for the party's time
pf.services.times: every 30 minutes inside the venue's hours; same-day bookings until 1 hour before; up to 30 days ahead
pf.services.notBookings: walk-ins are the open lanes at the counter; food, drinks and the bar are outside Rosie

beforeTimes: which lane or party, and the date and time
how many throwers, and each one's age group (adult, 12 to 17, or under 12)
for a party: the expected number of throwers
for a mobile lane: the kind of place (a yard, a company site, a school) and the town
afterTime: the birthday person's first name, if the booker wants it used
anything staff should know to help (answers about health stay on the secure page)
securePage: a waiver for every thrower: an adult signs their own; a parent or legal guardian signs for each thrower aged 12 to 17
the waiver's health check: a heart condition, a seizure disorder, a recent surgery, or a shoulder, back or neck injury (the answer stays on the secure page)
the party's guest list (first names only), and an emergency contact
for a mobile lane: the street address and a flat, clear area about 20 by 20 feet
pf.questions.whoMayBook: an adult (18 or over) books for the group; a parent or guardian books for a 12 to 17 year old; nobody under 12 is booked to throw
pf.questions.told: throwers stay behind the line and never walk into a lane while someone throws; the venue's own drink rule applies; arrive 15 minutes early to check in

stop.words: someone hit by an axe, or bleeding, hurt in the head, face or neck, or not breathing right now
stop.say: Call 911 now. Don't move someone with a head, neck or back injury.

goOn.words: a heart condition, a seizure disorder, a recent surgery, or a shoulder, back or neck injury
goOn.what: the booking can go on for the others; the waiver says who shouldn't throw; the person decides, and Rosie gives no health advice

pf.safety.atTheVenue: a thrower hurt at a lane: the host stops that lane, gives first aid, calls 911 when needed, and calls the parent at once if the parent isn't with them; an incident report goes on the secure page the same day; the owner is told
pf.safety.turnAway: anyone who seems drunk or high doesn't throw; a thrower who ignores the lane rules after a warning leaves the lane
pf.safety.weather: indoors: no weather limit; a mobile lane outdoors stops in lightning or high wind, as the crew decides

steps: a waiver for every thrower, signed on the secure page before the visit and good for 12 months; a parent signs for each 12 to 17 year old
the group's final headcount 3 days before (it sets the rest due on a party)
a mobile lane: the customer confirms the flat area, any outlet the crew needs, and any permission the place needs, 3 days before
pf.first_steps.prep: closed-toe shoes; comfortable clothes; arrive 15 minutes early

pf.visit.checkIn: at the front desk: the booker's code for the group; the desk sees which throwers have a waiver on file, and each one gets a wristband; the host checks the party in
pf.visit.lateEntry: the lane time ends at the set end; a late thrower gets the time left
pf.visit.missing: a thrower without a waiver signs on the desk tablet (a parent for a 12 to 17 year old) before throwing; only that thrower waits
pf.visit.changes: extra throwers on the day are added at the per-thrower price if the lane has room; the booker says yes first
pf.visit.children: nobody under 12 is booked to throw; 12 to 17 year olds throw only with a parent on site, who signs their waiver
pf.visit.done: the desk's check-in confirms the visit; the host texts DONE at the end of the party; the crew texts DONE after takedown

pf.money.before: lanes paid in full when booking; a party's $40 deposit; open lanes nothing before; a company event's $100 deposit
pf.money.after: a party's $160 rest at the counter for the final count; open lanes at the counter; a company event's $300 rest charged to the saved card when the crew texts DONE; a backyard party's bill texted after
pf.money.cancel: a lane: a full refund if moved or cancelled 2 hours or more before; a late cancel or no-show keeps $20. A party: free to cancel up to 7 days before; later the $40 deposit may be kept, only with the owner's yes. A company event keeps its $100 deposit on a late cancel, with the owner's yes
pf.money.membership: none: no monthly membership is sold through Rosie
pf.money.tips: a tip for the host on the venue's own reader, the business's own way; Rosie never asks
pf.money.fee2: Rosfield's $2 per confirmed booking applies: one $2 per booking, however many throwers
pf.money.noSale: food, drinks, gloves and merchandise are outside Rosie

pf.messages.never: children's names, ages and health answers, and injury details: only on the secure page
pf.messages.staffTexts: the host's day list shows the booker's name and the number of throwers; the guest list opens on the secure page
pf.messages.minors: texts go to the parent who booked, never to a 12 to 17 year old or a child

pf.staff.licenses: none from the state; first-aid and CPR cards for hosts, tracked by the venue
pf.staff.skills: lane host, party host, mobile lane crew
pf.staff.ratio: one host per 3 lanes, as the venue's safety plan sets; a mobile lane always has 2 crew
pf.staff.standIn: any trained host or crew member; nobody is booked by name
pf.staff.oks: the owner OKs refunds, party changes and anything over $500

pf.rules.waiver: no thrower at a lane without a signed waiver; a 12 to 17 year old's waiver signed only by a parent or legal guardian
pf.rules.lanes: one thrower per target area; throwers stay behind the line; the lane rules as the venue posts them
pf.rules.ages: adults, and 12 to 17 year olds with a parent on site; nobody under 12 is booked to throw
pf.rules.alcohol: alcohol and throwing are never mixed: anyone who has been drinking doesn't throw that day; drink service follows the venue's own rule and is never a Rosie step
pf.rules.inspections: the venue's daily lane checks, and the state's inspections where its rules require them
pf.rules.records: waivers kept as long as the insurer requires, and with the booking for 7 years; incident reports kept with the booking
pf.rules.cancelRight: no cancel period for lane time already given
pf.rules.reviews: a rating once after the visit, never after an injury

pf.edges.headcount: the group's final headcount 3 days before sets the rest; more on the day are added if a lane has room; fewer than 10 on a party still pay for 10
pf.edges.injury: a thrower hurt: first aid, 911 if needed, the parent called at once, an incident report the same day; no rating asked after it
pf.edges.noWaiver: a thrower without a waiver signs at the desk before throwing; only that thrower waits
pf.edges.impaired: a thrower who seems drunk or high doesn't throw; the rest of the group throws; no refund for that person
pf.edges.closed: a power cut or a lane problem closes the lanes: new times or a full refund
pf.edges.wind: a mobile lane: the crew stops in lightning or high wind; time lost to weather comes back as a partial refund or a new date
pf.edges.other: all other edge cases the generic way

notes: Axe throwing (T1, Oct 27, 2026): a lane venue (table style), from restaurant (copied; trampoline-park used as reference for lanes, groups and waivers). Flow A (the group comes to Lee Axe Lanes): one lane for 1 hour up to 4 throwers, $120 paid in full when booking, $20 kept on a late cancel or no-show (main); a birthday party for 10 throwers, $200: $40 deposit when booking, $160 rest paid at the counter for the final count, $40 kept on a late cancel; an open lane for 2 to 4, nothing taken, the bill at the counter. Flow B (Lee Mobile Axes comes to the customer): a company event, 2 lanes for 2 hours, $400: $100 deposit, $300 rest charged to the saved card when the crew texts DONE, $100 kept (main); a backyard party for 10 throwers, $240: a card saved for the $60 late-cancel fee, the bill texted after; a mobile lane at home for up to 4, $120 paid in full, $20 kept. Services (two per flow, for the mixed-booking examples): A a-add 'Extra 30 minutes on a lane' $20 (card, counter), a-full 'Lane, 1 hour (up to 4 throwers)' $120 paid in full; B b-add 'Extra 30 minutes at the party' $60 (card, bill), b-full 'Mobile lane, 1 hour at home' $120 paid in full.
